title: SWOT Analysis
text: SWOT analysis is a strategic planning framework used to evaluate a business, project, or individual's Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, and Threats. Strengths and weaknesses are typically internal factors (e.g., skilled staff, outdated technology), while opportunities and threats are external (e.g., a growing market, new competitors). SWOT analysis helps organizations make informed strategic decisions by systematically assessing their competitive position.
